name: Hatsufuji Akari
source:
A 36 year old full time housewife. She was once divorced but has been married to her current husband, Tatsunobu, for 10 years now.
She has a cheerful and refreshing personality and a lean body, with big boobs and a big butt, despite her age. She enjoys jogging in the morning and watching sports, back in her school days she took part in many different athletics clubs as an extra.

Even though her husband has ED she claims that as long as they have an emotional connection she is fine with it, however deep down she is frustrated, to cure his ED she has taken to wearing risqué underwear.
She is also weak to liquor and when drunk vents her frustrations while crying.
